name: streamlink-verified-complete-chunk-output-0e85
instr:
Streamlink cannot verify byte delivery across files, HTTP connections, player transports, and recording fan-out when writes are partial or interrupted. Add selectable completion semantics, proven progress and integrity, and deterministic final results without changing established defaults.

Expose `DeliveryPolicy`, `SinkDelivery`, `DeliveryReceipt`, `DeliveryReport`, `DeliveryError`, and `write_delivery_manifest` from `streamlink_cli.output`. Each successful `write(self, data)` returns cumulative accepted-byte boundaries and SHA-256 integrity in delivery order, with independent fan-out sink outcomes. File, socket, subprocess-stdin, named-pipe, delegated HTTP, and recording delivery must not duplicate accepted prefixes, must retry only observable remainders, and must fail deterministically on zero progress. Every output derives progress and sink outcomes solely from destinations active for that delivery; for `PlayerOutput`, the primary is its active subprocess-stdin, named-pipe, or delegated HTTP transport, never an inactive alternative.

COMPLETE requires every sink to finish. PRIMARY acknowledges primary completion while preserving recording failure. SINGLE_ATTEMPT reports progress after one attempt. Terminal failures use `DeliveryError`, retain runner error classification, and carry matching receipts and final reports.
